calculation.description: A lagged, risk-adjusted medium-term trend signal. Agreement across 20-, 60-, and 120-session returns is scaled by 60-session return divided by 40-session annualized volatility, then receives a 2x multiplier in a low-VIX regime and 1x otherwise. Uses only completed-session information.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10D IC in 2024-2026 (0.025251), 2027-2029 (0.010454), and 2033-2035 (0.031655); near-neutral in 2030-2032 (0.001009). 2020-2023 had no valid observations due to the rolling macro warm-up. Interpret uncertainty conservatively because the universe has 15 instruments.
